BiblicalUsage: When Scripture says híppos, it means horse. The word appears 16 times, and in James and Revelation it carries that same straightforward meaning. Nothing hidden sits behind it; the sense is the one you would expect from the word itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that híppos matters because horses are the Bible’s picture of power — and of power that cannot save. My position is simple: I take God at His word here, and I build on that.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
